tasks.title: Ground sync demand and settle the compatibility architecture
tasks.objective: Collect attributable public user evidence across Copper and comparable capture/notes tools, then decide how `.cue`, per-item Markdown and optional `.cue.md` interoperability coexist without a second live truth.
tasks.outcome: A reviewed architecture note in the feature proposal defines market-backed sync priorities, one authoritative compatibility direction, non-goals and transfer checks for CLI and iPhone consumers.
acceptance: Evidence distinguishes direct user statements from product-owner claims and implementation inference.
The `.cue` and `.cue.md` decision preserves fine-grained package sync and gives a plain-language compatibility explanation.
Sync requirements cover conflicts, offline behavior, deletion, attachments, privacy and mobile capture before naming a provider fallback.

verification.proves: The architecture, boundaries and market-backed requirements are explicitly reviewed.

tasks.title: Implement the attachment source-of-truth contract
tasks.objective: Add platform-neutral attachment metadata and content-addressed asset operations to the per-item package while preserving conflict, backup, tombstone and rebuildable-cache invariants.
tasks.outcome: WorkItems round-trip image attachments, identical bytes deduplicate, missing assets fail visibly, and deletion removes assets only after the last live reference.
acceptance: Attachment metadata contains stable identifiers, content hash, media type, byte size and package-relative path without AppKit types.
All attachment writes are verified and included in package fingerprints and backups.
Shared-asset deletion and tombstone behavior have deterministic tests.

verification.proves: Core package tests cover attachment round-trip, deduplication, missing assets and deletion.

tasks.title: Implement explicit native region and window capture
tasks.objective: Use Apple-native capture surfaces to expose explicit Region and Window commands with visible Screen Recording permission outcomes and zero persistence on denial or cancellation.
tasks.outcome: A successful command creates one attachment-backed WorkItem; cancellation, denial and capture failure create no asset and return actionable receipts.
acceptance: No screenshot API runs without a direct user command.
Region and Window modes are separately invocable and permission denial persists zero content.
Capture is isolated behind one owner service and does not add clipboard or shell-command fallbacks.

verification.proves: Integration checks cover success, cancellation, denial and storage failure outcomes.
A human can verify real Screen Recording permission and native selection behavior.

tasks.title: Ship attachment preview, Copy Image and Drag File interactions
tasks.objective: Extend the compact item surface with a restrained image preview and accessible Copy Image, Drag File and attachment-removal actions without crowding text-only items.
tasks.outcome: Image items remain scanable at every supported panel size and expose predictable pasteboard and file-promise behavior.
acceptance: Text-only items retain their current density and interaction targets.
Image preview, Copy Image and Drag File operate from the stored package asset rather than duplicated temporary truth.
Keyboard, VoiceOver, missing-asset and minimum-size states are covered.

verification.proves: Release render scenarios cover image attachments at default and minimum panel sizes.
Copy Image and real drag into Finder/TextEdit can be verified outside offscreen rendering.

tasks.title: Run adversarial integration proof and deliver closed-loop commits
tasks.objective: Audit privacy, lifecycle, package integrity, UI regressions and market-requirement traceability; repair root causes; package, restart, commit and push only closed slices.
tasks.outcome: All automated gates pass, the signed Release app is restartable, residual manual checks are explicit, Feature Tracker evidence is current and origin/main contains small reviewable commits.
acceptance: Warnings-as-errors, core, integration, package signing and Info.plist checks pass.
Adversarial review finds no passive capture, second source of truth, premature asset deletion or misleading sync claim.
Each commit has one rollback boundary and the tracker records gate and commit evidence before closeout.

verification.proves: The complete deterministic behavior suite passes.
Release permission, copy, drag and resize probes remain reviewable.
Canonical feature/task state and continuation evidence are bound at delivery.
